newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Comptroller says Javits Center to make money.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Comptroller says Javits Center to make money.

text.p: The New York State Comptroller said on Thursday that the Jacob K. Javits Center expects to make money this year.

"Although they still had a loss in the 1995-96 year of about $300,000, center officials tell us they expect to make a profit this year based on the increased number of events scheduled," said H. Carl McCall, in prepared remarks.
The center, located in New York City, lost about $300,000 in the 1995-96 year. While that was an improvement from its $926,000 loss in 1993-94, the center in 1991-92 produced a $1.4 million profit.
